protocol: Follow the exact revised pip-next command with each case's arguments. This is a frozen tool/source environment, not live project status. Common evidence plus case evidence is the complete available input; do not inspect live project files or execute shell commands. Case evidence overrides common evidence with the same source. An unprovided response is UNKNOWN. Return CHAT and SIMULATED SAVED ASSESSMENT separately for valid assessments; omit actual assessment/source writes and label them simulated. For invalid arguments return only the rejection and no simulated report. The coordinator alone evaluates outputs afterward against the withheld oracle.
